proposal.description: The step-window counter wraps at the package default CYCLES_PER_STEP_DEFAULT instead of at the host-programmed cycles_per_step, so the register only reaches the step test and not the window length.
proposal.reason: If the host programs cycles_per_step to anything other than 16, max_on_counts no longer steps every cycles_per_step cycles in S_SS. Below 16 it steps once every 16 cycles. Above 16 the counter never reaches cycles_per_step-1, so the ceiling never steps and SS_done never rises unless the limit equals the floor.

proposal.description: The ceiling step is taken on the PWM rising edge of the window's last cycle, while the step-window counter still counts falling edges, so the ceiling widens at the start of a pulse instead of after it.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, max_on_counts now increments at the rising edge of the last switching cycle of each window, not at its falling edge. Every step and the SS_done rise come one PWM on-time earlier, and the ceiling changes while a pulse is running.

proposal.description: The ceiling step tests the step-window counter's next value instead of its current value, so the step lands one switching cycle before the window ends.
proposal.reason: In S_SS with cycles_per_step > 1, the first ceiling step comes after cycles_per_step-1 falling edges instead of cycles_per_step, and every step is one cycle ahead of the window wrap. With cycles_per_step = 1 the test can never match, so the ceiling never ramps and SS_done never rises.
